decision_boundary: No upstream correction is required merely to preserve an already-reviewed local rejection while consuming an immutable product as evidence. Upstream exact equivalence remains unaccepted locally. If complete row/native witness scope differs or a conflict lacks current finite scientific review, it remains a blocker pending review.
existing_basis: Current identity policy has a finite generic-name exclusion and the exact MIM-to-CHEBI pair exclusion; it does not globally reject CHEBI:86658.

The retained P3556 scope review distinguishes whole egg-yolk product quantity from a particular acyl/stereochemical molecule; retained source has no CAS assertion. This assessment cites retained prior review, not new supplier verification.
The prior reviewed design explicitly preserves canonical supported MIM bytes as conditional material_scope_supported audit evidence after the derived unified artifact removes the held pair.
Explicitly structured native molecular synonyms remain eligible; local P3556 observations preserve their exact native source identity and quantities.
method: Independent read-only current policy, historical scope document, immutable fixture and builder control-flow review. No producer, validator, runtime probe, candidate generation or network access. Exact current native-claim comparison is assigned separately to environment reviewer.
minimal_acceptable_integration: Retain the complete upstream supported/withheld products, pin, dates, original fields and partition without reclassifying or rewriting publisher data.

Authorize only an explicit finite already-reviewed local disposition, bound to the complete actual upstream row, product/manifest identity, current policy bytes and retained native/source witness. New or changed unreviewed conflicts still abort.

Emit a separate complete native-claim hold record with all source fields, occurrence/multiplicity and identity; do not truncate the upstream 14-column row into the unified 13-column schema. Historical baseline quarantine and current native held claims must remain distinguishable.

Reconcile native supported claims into materialized exact, reviewed held exact and nonidentity broader counts; never report all upstream supported claims as active KGM identity mappings. Derived relation counts remain separate from upstream claim counts.

Exclude held exact claims from positive identity/name/xref/formula evidence and from broader projection licensing, including aliases in other/object_label. A broader claim that needs a held exact sibling must fail rather than acquire support.
Continue historical exact-edge contamination cleanup from actual old evidence; do not use a held current assertion to invent identity connections or suppress unrelated native structural routes.
Retain explicit structured native names/categories/formulas under current scientific policies; do not globally remove the target to obtain a clean audit.

Prove exact legacy/current held-row preservation, rejected generic name/xref plus retained native structured controls, correct full count partition, unfamiliar/mutated-conflict refusal, no held-parent projection, second-cycle stability, real runtime behavior and full-source material audit.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not change runtime identity policy to accept the upstream claim.
Do not silently drop/continue on all current or future policy errors.
Do not change the supported table to make the local projection appear upstream-approved.
Do not replace the generic claim with a guessed broader class, CAS, charge state or other molecular identity.
Do not reuse failed candidate-r1 as acceptance evidence.
